description: Small Python tasks with unit tests. Each has a signature and docstring (for completion-style models) and an instruction (for instruction-tuned models).

problems.name: add
problems.doc: Return the sum of a and b.
problems.instruction: Write a Python function add(a, b) that returns the sum of a and b.

problems.name: is_even
problems.doc: Return True if the integer n is even, otherwise False.
problems.instruction: Write a Python function is_even(n) that returns True if the integer n is even and False otherwise.

problems.name: reverse_string
problems.instruction: Write a Python function reverse_string(s) that returns the string s reversed.

problems.name: factorial
problems.doc: Return n! (the factorial of the non-negative integer n). factorial(0) is 1.
problems.instruction: Write a Python function factorial(n) that returns the factorial of a non-negative integer n, where factorial(0) is 1.

problems.name: count_vowels
problems.doc: Return how many vowels (a, e, i, o, u, upper or lower case) are in the string s.
problems.instruction: Write a Python function count_vowels(s) that returns the number of vowels (a, e, i, o, u, upper or lower case) in the string s.

problems.name: find_max
problems.doc: Return the largest number in the non-empty list numbers.
problems.instruction: Write a Python function find_max(numbers) that returns the largest number in a non-empty list of numbers.

problems.name: is_palindrome
problems.doc: Return True if the string s reads the same forwards and backwards, ignoring case.
problems.instruction: Write a Python function is_palindrome(s) that returns True if the string s reads the same forwards and backwards, ignoring case, and False otherwise.

problems.name: fibonacci
problems.doc: Return the n-th Fibonacci number, where fibonacci(0) is 0 and fibonacci(1) is 1.
problems.instruction: Write a Python function fibonacci(n) that returns the n-th Fibonacci number, where fibonacci(0) is 0 and fibonacci(1) is 1.

problems.name: remove_duplicates
problems.doc: Return a new list with duplicates removed, keeping the first occurrence of each item in order.
problems.instruction: Write a Python function remove_duplicates(items) that returns a new list with duplicates removed, keeping the first occurrence of each item in its original order.

problems.name: celsius_to_fahrenheit
problems.doc: Convert a temperature from Celsius to Fahrenheit.
problems.instruction: Write a Python function celsius_to_fahrenheit(c) that converts a temperature from Celsius to Fahrenheit.

problems.name: is_prime
problems.doc: Return True if the integer n is a prime number, otherwise False.
problems.instruction: Write a Python function is_prime(n) that returns True if the integer n is a prime number and False otherwise.

problems.name: word_count
problems.doc: Return a dictionary mapping each word in text (split on whitespace) to how many times it appears.
problems.instruction: Write a Python function word_count(text) that returns a dictionary mapping each word in text (split on whitespace) to the number of times it appears.
